data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened the year with gross claims outstanding of 5,878.4 (USD millions). During 2023 the managing agent refined its reserving methodology (including the actuarial approach to the risk margin and future claims handling expense provisioning), which was accounted for prospectively and resulted in a net release of reserves of $64.7m (USD), equivalent to a ~1.10% release of opening gross claims outstanding. No gross prior-year movement was explicitly disclosed; the reported figure is a net release attributable to the change of estimate.
raw_causal_phrases: the managing agent refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin to determine the appropriate level of margin in reserves and updating the calculation methodology behind the provision for future claims handling expenses.
As a result of these changes, $64.7m of reserves were released in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement was presented in the provided notes. The report explicitly states a $64.7m release "on a net of reinsurance basis" due to a change of estimate/methodology; therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the NET figure as a fallback. Opening reserves come from the balance sheet (gross claims outstanding comparative column). All monetary amounts are reported in the syndicate's functional currency (USD millions). Confidence for the prior year movement is reduced because a gross figure was not available and the net figure was used.
